data.name: ButtonHelp
data.value: Connect to Synology Office (Spreadsheet) tables on a Synology NAS

data.name: LongDescription
data.value: Loads the sheets of a Synology Office (.osheet) spreadsheet from its link. DSM exports the spreadsheet to xlsx.

data.name: BaseUrlDescription
data.value: The NAS base address, e.g. https://nas:5001 — one set of credentials covers the whole NAS

data.name: TableUrlDescription
data.value: A Synology Office spreadsheet link; leave empty to only test the connection

data.name: ErrorUnknownUrl
data.value: Could not recognize the link. Expected https://nas/oo/r/<id>, https://nas/d/f/<id>, https://nas/?file_id=<id>, or https://nas/?path=/mydrive/file.osheet

data.name: ErrorNotSpreadsheet
data.value: The link does not point to a Synology Office (.osheet) spreadsheet.

data.name: ErrorExport
data.value: DSM did not return an xlsx when exporting the spreadsheet.

data.name: ErrorHttpsRequired
data.value: Connections are only allowed over HTTPS; otherwise the DSM password would travel in clear text. Use an address like https://nas:5001/...

data.name: ErrorNotDsm
data.value: The server did not return a DSM Web API response. Check the NAS address and port.

data.name: DsmAuth403
data.value: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled for this account. Use a dedicated service account without 2FA.

data.name: DsmAuth406
data.value: The administrator requires 2FA for this account. Use a service account without 2FA.

data.name: DsmAuth407
data.value: The IP address is blocked by DSM auto-block.

data.name: DsmCommon102
data.value: API not found. Make sure Synology Drive Server and Synology Office are installed on the NAS.

data.name: DsmCommon105
data.value: No permission to access the file (or the session is invalid).

data.name: DsmFilesHint
data.value: . Check the table link and the user's access to it.
